content.text:
I fixed the wrong slots on clock-change days. On 28 March 2027 in Berlin, the first slot is now 10:00 local (08:00Z) and the last one ends at 20:00. Winter time start (31 October) opens at 10:00 too. `pnpm test` passes. I did not run `pnpm build`, and the integration tests and dev server can't run here, so nothing was checked against a real booking page.

**Cause:** `localTimeToUtc` in `src/lib/slots.ts` read the timezone offset once, at 00:00 UTC of the date. On a clock-change day the offset changes during the day, so every opening and closing time came out an hour off.

**Fix:**
- **`src/lib/slots.ts`:** `localTimeToUtc` now works out the offset that applies at the requested wall time. For a wall time that happens twice when clocks go back, it takes the earlier one. For a wall time that doesn't exist when clocks go forward, such as 02:30 in Berlin on 28 March, it shifts forward to 03:30.
- **`src/app/admin/page.tsx`:** the calendar's day range was start of day plus a fixed 24 hours, which cuts bookings off on 23- and 25-hour days. It now ends at the next local midnight.
- **`src/lib/slots.test.ts`:** I added tests for the Berlin spring and autumn days and the New York spring day.

I also spot-checked 2027 dates in Asia/Kolkata and Australia/Lord_Howe. Both gave the right times.
